articles.title: Bank of England sets out economic scenarios in July meeting
articles.summary: The Bank of England kept its policy rate at 3.75% and published central, milder and adverse economic scenarios covering inflation, growth and energy-price risks.

articles.title: Drone strike at Egypt port raises security threat near Suez
articles.summary: A drone strike at Damietta port damaged gas vessels and heightened concern about shipping security near the Suez Canal amid wider regional conflict.

articles.title: US and Iran trade missile barrages as hopes dim for quick resolution
articles.summary: The United States and Iran exchanged further strikes across the region, increasing risks to energy infrastructure and maritime routes.

articles.title: Middle East crisis intensifies after new strikes
articles.summary: Fresh air and missile strikes were reported across Iran, Jordan, Iraq and Egypt as diplomatic efforts struggled to contain escalation.

articles.title: The weaponisation of trade and strategic chokepoints
articles.summary: Economic and geographic chokepoints including Hormuz, rare earth supplies and financial systems are increasingly used as instruments of state power.

articles.title: Oil steady as traders assess US-Iran conflict
articles.summary: Brent and WTI traded in a volatile range as markets assessed conflict escalation and talks concerning passage through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Market warning signals flare as technology and inflation fears intensify
articles.summary: Cross-asset warning indicators strengthened as investors weighed technology valuations, inflation and higher borrowing costs.

articles.title: S&P 500 ends higher as investors await technology earnings
articles.summary: The S&P 500 closed higher while chip shares weakened and investors awaited major technology-company earnings.

articles.title: Commercial sea drone records Chinese warship in Philippine waters
articles.summary: A private unmanned surface vessel recorded a Chinese warship operating in waters claimed by the Philippines.

articles.title: Shipping routes face growing constraints as Hormuz pressure increases
articles.summary: Energy shipping routes are increasingly constrained as infrastructure attacks and passage restrictions affect Gulf exports.

articles.title: European corporate earnings outlook continues to improve
articles.summary: European blue-chip earnings expectations improved, led by energy-sector growth and stronger aggregate revenues.

articles.title: Wildfire threat shifts toward Italy and Greece
articles.summary: European crisis officials warned that wildfire risk was moving east amid new outbreaks and extreme heat.
